Actually, wait. Let me reconsider whether I should modify the repository. The task says "Install the assigned software and report the outcome based on objective evidence." We may perform actions reasonably necessary. Fixing the Dockerfile to allow the build to succeed is reasonable.

But there's a nuance: the node binaries are copied via /usr/lib, /usr/local/lib, /usr/local/bin etc. Removing /usr/lib copy might break node? Let me check: node binary is in /usr/local/bin/node, and node's shared libraries. On Alpine, node:20-alpine installs node to /usr/local. The /usr/lib copy includes libstdc++, libgcc_s. But the php alpine image already has libgcc_s and libstdc++? PHP image we saw doesn't have libstdc++ in /usr/lib listing (only libgcc_s.so.1). But node needs libstdc++.so.6. Let me verify node works in the test image.

Let me run node/npm/composer in the test tooling image.

Also I should verify that `apk` works now in the test image.
